first_entry.line: Okay. THIS is the Europe I flew six hours for.
They got a bidet for a bar stool. That's culture, bro. That's, like, history.

vip_arrows.line: VIP's this way. I knew it. I can smell exclusivity.
It's a private entrance. Opens right onto the bar. Very exclusive. Nobody else is using it.

bidet_examine: A porcelain bidet bolted to a brass bar-stool base. The menu calls it "reclaimed European seating." It is the last stool anyone chooses.
street_cabinet: A sticker-bombed arcade cabinet left out on the cobblestones, rain-warped and dead. Its screen reads OUT OF ORDER. It still costs 1 SOV.
chalkboard: The chalkboard promises a REAL ARCADE, REAL ABSINTHE and REAL BAD DECISIONS. The first two are technically true.
window_cat: A black cat sits on the open first-floor sill, motionless, watching the street like it pays rent. It does not acknowledge you.
flyer_before: A corkboard strangled under six layers of club flyers, each one promising the most exclusive night of your life. None of them are.
flyer_after: Your DJ Beatdrop flyer now covers a flyer for a night that also claimed to be unmissable. Yours is the one with the rainbow WordArt.

lines: The corridor runs about four frames behind. I stop moving and let my afterimage do the switches. He's better at the order than I am.
Three switches down there, and my reflection hits them in an order I've never once managed. I don't ask what the order opens. I watch.
I don't play the corridor anymore. My reflection plays it and I take the credit. Best co-op partner I've ever had.
Stop trying to be early. Be late on purpose. In this building, late is the only honest render.
I've got a reaction time of 0.3. My reflection's got 0.1. We don't talk about it. We don't talk at all, technically.
I keep a spreadsheet of every reflection in this building. Yours has its own tab. That is not a compliment.
You found the curtain. Everyone finds the curtain. The curtain finds you first, honestly.
There's a room past the green with no floor in it. We go there on the drop. We come back a slightly different shape.
Achievement unlocked: still here. Nobody redeems it. We tried. The redemption counter is also a ghost.
Watch the green on the bassline. It breathes in time. That's not a metaphor, that's a maintenance issue they've given up on.
There's a beer in the back that shows you yourself. We all had one. We're still dancing, so.
We've been dancing to this song since before your divorce.
She wrote a verse about me. Three hostels later it had a chorus and a key change. I don't even remember the night it's about.
I heard your ballad in a Sinfonia kitchen. Different words, same last line. Everybody's beautiful, everybody's broken, somebody's paying.
There's a network. Not the hostels — the network. You leave a page in a kitchen and it comes back as a song with your name misspelled.
Nothing in this city is authentic except the prices. Four years and I've stopped correcting people about it.
The regulars aren't locals. The regulars are tourists who ran out of money and quietly stopped mentioning the return flight.
This is the last honest place in the city. It robs you out in the open. The museums do it with a gift shop and a pamphlet.
The broken DDR's the only machine in here that takes three tokens and gives you a door instead of tickets. Best route in the building.
Nineteen seconds, door to toilet. Three tokens, one left-side smack, and I'm through before the third pip finishes lighting.
Nobody runs the DDR route for tickets. There are no tickets. There's a door. That's the entire run. That's why it's beautiful.
My PB is door-to-bucket in eleven seconds. The bucket's a foot soak. Don't ask. Route through it, soak in it, question your life choices later.
Three pips light up green and the whole north wing rearranges itself around you. I timed the indicator change. 0.4 seconds. Beautiful.
Speedrunners don't use the bathroom. We route through it. There's a difference and the difference is a timer.

jakub_sea_monkeys_win: You won! The big one! Nobody wins the big one. I have to tell the machine. She will be devastated.

quest_objectives.the_tip: Tip Tomáš at the prize counter.
quest_objectives.the_girls_round: Buy the birthday girls a round at the bar.
quest_objectives.the_unsettled_tab: Settle the tab with Tomáš, or leave without paying.
quest_objectives.tab_paid: The tab is paid. Tomáš appreciates the tip.
quest_objectives.tab_open: The tab is still open. It now includes a service charge.
quest_objectives.tab_stolen: The tab and service charge were taken from your wallet — or whatever was in it.

grandpa_loss.staging: (The two men crack their knuckles. The screen goes black. The bros wake face-down on the cobblestones outside the Arcade.)
